A beaker containing a sample of liquid water is heated at its boiling point until it has completely turned into steam. The process occurs at a constant atmospheric pressure. Which of the following correctly describes the change in the temperature of the substance and the change in its internal energy during this phase transition?

TemperatureInternal energy

B.constantincreases
